# AWS IAM Identity Center — Identity Store

Store Identity Center users, groups and group memberships without directory synchronization or sign-in.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `identitystore` |
| Signing name | `identitystore` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2020-06-15` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 18 of 22 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-iam-identity-center-identity-store) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No sign-in, SCIM, external identity providers, directory synchronization, identity store management, extensions or additional user attributes.
- No tagging API exists for Identity Store; resources are untagged.
- Only userName, displayName, name, name.givenName, name.familyName and emails update paths, plus group displayName/description; removing required names fails.
- Identity store IDs must match the account’s built-in store; additional stores and legacy identity stores are excluded.
- No membership Describe operation, revision concurrency controls, service quotas or attribute indexes; unsupported modeled input members reject through the generated AWS JSON decoder.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
